text: The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic boom-bap drums, syncopated basslines, and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. The rhythmic cadence of the verses mirrors the staccato rhythm of traffic and footsteps, while the raw, unpolished production values reflect the textured, weathered surfaces of metropolitan architecture. This auditory layering creates an immersive environment where the pulse of the music aligns with the visual narrative of modern existence.
